domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
t is a real number satisfying 0 <= t < 1
floor is taken of the real number n*t and equals an integer
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: Given any integer n > 1 and any real t with 0 <= t < 1, the statement floor(n*t) equals n - 1 is equivalent to t lying in the interval from (n - 1) / n inclusive up to 1 (exclusive).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all real numbers t with 0 <= t and t < 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: quantified parameter; divisor in n*t and in (n-1)/n

variables.name: t
variables.role: quantified input to the floor expression n*t

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, floor(n*t) = n-1 if and only if (n-1)/n <= t < 1.
